program.section_heading: American Sign Language Certificate of Career Preparation
outcomes: Acquired fundamental understanding of the principles and practices of American Sign Language

Acquired fundamental knowledge of the Code of Professional Conduct per the National Association of the Deaf (NAD) and the Registry of Interpreters for the Deaf, Inc. (RID), which will assist students in their participation in an Interpreters Training Program.

blocks.name: Electives: Choose a minimum of one course from the list below

notes: The catalog text is for the 'American Sign Language Certificate of Career Preparation' (15 units), not a Certificate of Achievement of 16 to fewer than 30 units as the program record states; the source URL also references 2019-20 Fall 2019. A reviewer should confirm this is the correct award and catalog year.
Catalog prints ASL codes without a space (ASL131, ASL134); these are treated as matching closed-list ASL 131 and ASL 134.
Catalog lists each ASL course at 3 units, while the state file stores 4 units for ASL 131 and ASL 134.
Core block reads 'Complete the following number of credits: 12' with four 3-unit courses, so all four are required; recorded as 'all'.
Electives block says 'Choose a minimum of one course' and 'Complete the following number of credits: 3'; recorded as choose 1 course (3 units).
The description also mentions qualifying for 'an entry level position assisting the deaf or hard of hearing'; not recorded as a career title.
